therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: angiogenesis inhibition and tumor growth suppression
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with advanced pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (pNET) or extra-pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (epNET) including carcinoid tumors

results.effect_size: epNET: median PFS 8.4 vs 3.9 months; pNET: median PFS 13.8 vs 4.4 months
subgroup_findings: epNET cohort: cabozantinib median PFS 8.4 months vs placebo 3.9 months (p<0.0001)
pNET cohort: cabozantinib median PFS 13.8 months vs placebo 4.4 months (p<0.0001)
epNET cohort: OS 21.9 vs 19.7 months (p=0.2438, not significant)
pNET cohort: OS 40.0 vs 31.1 months (p=0.4426, not significant)
epNET cohort: radiographic response rate 7 vs 0 responders (p=0.05)
pNET cohort: radiographic response rate 12 vs 0 responders (p=0.01)
safety_signals: Grade 3+ AEs occurred in 104/134 cabozantinib patients (epNET) vs 47/69 placebo patients (epNET)
Grade 3+ AEs occurred in 49/64 cabozantinib patients (pNET) vs 22/31 placebo patients (pNET)
Serious AEs included abdominal pain, acute kidney injury, alkaline phosphatase increased, anemia, and others

context.indication: advanced pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (pNET) and extra-pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors / carcinoid tumors (epNET)
context.duration: PFS assessed at 36 months; OS assessed at 60 months
